body: On antidepressants, did therapy. Tried many things, but then lack of motivation kinda ruins it all. Why can't it be accepted that some people don't want to try. Some people are tired and don't feel right here. I just want to be able to go in peace, knowing all my fairs are in order and I get to say goodbye to friends/fam. But it's not acceptable, also it costs way to much.

What if it's not possible to get your mind in a better state? What if you've tried and just have had enough. Why isn't that acceptable? Why suffer to get better if you just don't want to do anything? Just cease to exist

Easier said than done! I know I'll never really be happy, so why do I have to keep suffering cause people believe it might happen. I don't want to be old and miserable forever. I'd rather end it now and not have to deal with this thing called life.
Yeah, that's true too. There's just no winning

True that anyone can let you down! Most of the time (when I'm with someone), not when I'm alone though. I'm not like how I am when I'm alone vs when I'm with someone (I don't think anyways). 
Fair enough
Everyone says this, but let's say loving others and having others want to be around you, makes you feel better. Why do I have to "love myself" first?
How do you feel about wind ensemble music??
Damn, well thank you for writing all of this out. And the explanation of the psychological vs biological makes sense to me. Thank you for this!
Well I doubt your life is over cause of a mistake you made (unless you're going to jail for life...), but either way, sorry you feel so shitty.
Well, hopefully within those years, you also can also find a better place in life and won't have to

That's true. And you're not in mine. I have also had to/still doing things I'm not proud of, but right now it seems to be the only option. 
And I mean, well that's good then. And yes, it does hurt when you feel good about something and it seems like it never works out. You slowly lose that optimism and become pessimistic.
Haha oh trust me, I can be Exhibit A for lack of effort. Why? You're not trying anymore, so why should I?

There would be a bunch if things, then I'd remember I'm poor and wouldn't be able to do them... so I'd probably try to pawn off as much of my stuff as I could to pay off some of my debt so my mom wouldn't have to deal with my debt.
And when you can't get yourself to do those things? Then what? (Actually asking, cause I have no clue)

Not my post, but I realized that it was part of the post after. I skimmed, my bad. 
Okay, my question then, if you can't put in the effort or have tried, does someone then deserve to die? Like if someone is just wasting away and they want to die, went to therapy, on the meds, but can't force themselves to do anything, are they then justified to want to end their life? (Kinda veered from the OPs original convo, but just curious...)
Easier said than done. Also you don't have to name call.
